operating_notes.text: Vibrancy Real Estates Private Limited (VREPL) to be a 50:50 joint venture between Brigade Enterprises and GSS India Opportunities AIF Scheme I for developing a 2 million sq ft office and hotel project in Whitefield, Bangalore.
Acquired 5.72 acres of land at Osman Nagar, Hyderabad via TGIIC auction at ₹44 Cr per acre for a residential project.
Vibrancy Real Estates Private Limited became a 50:50 joint venture on April 29, 2026.
Brigade Group and Bain Capital formed a 50:50 joint venture with an investment of approximately ₹2,200 Cr to develop a ~2 mn sq ft mixed-use project in Whitefield, Bengaluru.
Recommended a final dividend of ₹2 per share and a bonus issue in the ratio of 1:3.
FY26 pre-sales volume stood at 6.13 mn sft with average realization of INR 12,622/sft.
Board proposed a bonus issue in the ratio of 1:3 and an increase in authorized share capital from ₹250 Cr to ₹400 Cr.
FY26 pre-sales stood at ₹7,424 Cr across 6.13 mn sft with average realization of ₹12,107/sft.
BuzzWorks launched Brigade Vantage in Mysuru with 500+ seats and announced a multi-city expansion blueprint covering Bengaluru and Chennai.
Signed JDA for a 5.6-acre residential project in Kompally, Hyderabad with ₹850 Cr revenue potential.
Q1FY27 realisation was ₹14,256 per sq ft, up 21% YoY, on pricing increases and a shift to higher-value homes.
Commercial office portfolio was 8 msf at 88% occupancy; GCCs were 58% of Q1 gross leasing and IT/ITES 26% of the portfolio mix.
Unsold inventory value was ₹8,950 Cr across 6.7 msf, including 0.7 msf of Morgan Heights with ₹650 Cr attributable value.
Signed management agreements with Hyatt Hotels Corporation for two Hyatt Regency hotels in Bengaluru totaling 600 rooms (350 rooms at Brigade Global Park, 250 rooms on Whitefield-Kadugodi Road).
Incorporated Celebrations Property Private Limited and Tetrarch Estates Private Limited as wholly owned subsidiaries on 1 September 2026.

timeline.summary: Brigade Enterprises entered into agreements with GSS India Opportunities AIF to form a 50:50 joint venture for developing an 11.04-acre land parcel in Whitefield, Bangalore.
Brigade Enterprises acquired 5.72 acres of land in Osman Nagar, Hyderabad, through a TGIIC auction at ₹44 Cr per acre to develop a residential project.
Brigade Enterprises converted Vibrancy Real Estates into a 50:50 JV with GSS India Opportunities AIF following a ₹439.75 Cr investment.
Brigade Enterprises announced a 50:50 joint venture with Bain Capital to invest ₹2,200 Cr in a 2 mn sq ft mixed-use project in Whitefield, Bengaluru.
Brigade Enterprises Ltd. invites analysts to a conference call on May 7, 2026, at 2:30 PM IST to discuss Q4 FY‘26 financial and operational results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,457.6 Cr (-0.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹145.49 Cr (-41.1% YoY).
Brigade Enterprises released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation detailing pre-sales of ₹7,424 Cr and consolidated revenue of ₹5,909 Cr.
Brigade Enterprises issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for a 1:3 bonus issue and an increase in authorized share capital to ₹400 Cr.
Brigade Enterprises reported Q4 FY26 pre-sales of ₹2,521 Cr and FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹5,909 Cr, with management guiding for over 20% pre-sales growth in FY27.
Brigade Enterprises' managed office brand BuzzWorks entered Mysuru with Brigade Vantage and unveiled its 2026 multi-city expansion blueprint on May 15, 2026.
Brigade Enterprises signed a JDA for an ₹850 Cr premium residential project in Kompally, Hyderabad on May 25, 2026.
On June 8, 2026, Brigade Enterprises announced that shareholders approved increasing authorised capital to ₹400 Cr and issuing a 1:3 bonus share through a postal ballot.
Shareholders via remote e-voting approved resolutions on June 7, 2026, with 98.82% assent and 1.18% dissent for 229,948,634 equity shares.

On 14 August 2026 Brigade's Q1FY27 call kept FY27 presales guidance at ₹9,000 Cr, reported PAT of ₹217 Cr (up 37%) and said the Morgan Heights relaunch was stalled by a revoked environmental clearance.
Brigade Group signed management agreements with Hyatt Hotels Corporation for two new Hyatt Regency hotels (600 rooms) in Bengaluru.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,196.36 Cr (-13.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹193.73 Cr (+19.2% YoY).
Om Prakash, Chairman, Brigade Enterprises Limited, uploaded Q2 FY 2026-27 conference call recording on October 30, 2026.
